nodes.label: Server.run
nodes.desc: Composition root: wires printer, fileManager, analysisQueue, eventManager, pluginManager globals, then starts Tornado.

nodes.label: CustomHTTPServer
nodes.desc: Tornado HTTP server that fronts the Flask WSGI app, handles uploads, proxies and webcam snapshots.

nodes.label: Permissions
nodes.desc: Metaclass-backed permission registry powering the role model on every route.

nodes.label: UserManager
nodes.desc: User storage and sessions; the filebased manager ships by default.

nodes.label: login()
nodes.desc: Session login endpoint under /api/login.

nodes.label: controlJob()
nodes.desc: POST /api/job: start, pause, cancel, restart the current print job.

nodes.label: uploadGcodeFile()
nodes.desc: Multipart upload endpoint that writes files into a storage and kicks off analysis.

nodes.label: connectionCommand()
nodes.desc: POST /api/connection: connect, disconnect, port/baudrate autodetection.

nodes.label: printerCommand()
nodes.desc: POST /api/printer/command: jog, home, extrude, set temperature.

nodes.label: PrinterStateConnection
nodes.desc: Per-browser SockJS session: receives client messages, pushes state deltas and events.

nodes.label: on_message()
nodes.desc: Parses JSON client commands (auth, job, temperature, custom controls).

nodes.label: PluginManager
nodes.desc: Discovery from entry points and folders, import, validation, enable/disable.

nodes.label: PluginInfo
nodes.desc: Per-plugin metadata wrapper exposing hooks and implementations.

nodes.label: OctoPrintPlugin
nodes.desc: Base class of all plugin implementation mixins.

nodes.label: BlueprintPlugin
nodes.desc: Mixin letting plugins register their own Flask blueprints at /api/plugin/<name>.

nodes.label: EventHandlerPlugin
nodes.desc: Mixin for plugins that react to Events.* via on_event().

nodes.label: ConnectedPrinter
nodes.desc: Metaclass registry: connector plugins register on subclassing, find() resolves by name.

nodes.label: ConnectedPrinterState
nodes.desc: Link-level states: OPENING, CONNECTING, CONNECTED, CLOSED_WITH_ERROR, OFFLINE...

nodes.label: ConnectedSerialPrinter
nodes.desc: Bundled serial connector; bridges Printer callbacks to the serial engine and registers itself.

nodes.label: MachineCom
nodes.desc: Serial engine: protocol handling, ack parsing, SD support, resend recovery, queues.

nodes.label: _monitor()
nodes.desc: Readline loop that parses temperatures, acks, errors and prompts from the printer.

nodes.label: SendQueue
nodes.desc: Ordered transmit queue that keeps G-code flowing at the printer's pace.

nodes.label: StreamingGcodeFileInformation
nodes.desc: Job file wrapper that feeds G-code lines to the queue during a print.

nodes.label: Printer
nodes.desc: Facade holding connection, job and state; subscribes to analysis and fires events.

nodes.label: StateMonitor
nodes.desc: 0.5s interval loop invoking data/temperature/log callbacks for clients.

nodes.label: cancel_print()
nodes.desc: Pause, resume, cancel transitions around set_job/start_print.

nodes.label: PrintTimeEstimator
nodes.desc: Rolling duration estimate refined from observed line timing during a print.

nodes.label: FileManager
nodes.desc: list_files/add_file/move_file across storage backends plus the extension tree.

nodes.label: GcodeAnalysisQueue
nodes.desc: Background worker queue; fires MetadataAnalysisStarted/Finished events.

nodes.label: gcode
nodes.desc: Model-aware G-code parser computing duration, filament usage and object bounds.

nodes.label: SlicingManager
nodes.desc: Orchestrates slicer plugins and profile management.

nodes.label: EventManager
nodes.desc: fire(event, payload) with subscribe/unsubscribe and typed subscriptions.

nodes.label: TimelapseRenderJob
nodes.desc: Stitches captured frames into timelapse videos after a print finishes.
